verdict.rationale: Orb is a usage-based billing platform that could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only a REST API, multi-language SDKs and an llms.txt file, with no mention of a CLI. SDKs and APIs are developer building blocks, not a CLI, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
